messages:
Maya R: Postmortem uploaded for the recurring GPU pool spike that raised p95 last Thursday. Need owners for remediation + decide if SLO changes are warranted.
Dan C: Postmortem link: https://redwood.internal/pm/2026-pool-spike. Root cause looks like KVCACHE eviction storms triggered by bursty tokenization patterns.
Ashley P: Agree on owners. Quick Q: do we want to relax p95 SLO or instead add temporary mitigations?
Leo H: Prefer not to change SLO permanently. Suggest a short tolerance window and operational guardrails: pool isolation, throttles, and canaries. Re-evaluate after 14 days.
ops-oncall: Ops note: this service hit its error budget twice this quarter. Without throttles/fallbacks the burn will continue. Requesting pool-level isolation ASAP.
incident-bot: Incident 2026 closed  root cause: kvcache_eviction_burst -> queue buildup. Duration 00:18:34.
Maya R: Short proposal: 1) Dashboards & alerts (owner: Leo) - add p50/p95/p99, kvcache_hit_rate, queue_length, incident annotations. 2) Pool isolation config (owner: Dan) - tenant isolation + burst throttle. 3) Canary + rollback runbook (owner: Ashley) - traffic ramp + auto-fallback to smaller model variant. 4) 2-week audit window, no permanent SLO change yet. Deadlines: Leo Tue EOD, Dan Fri EOD, Ashley next Wed.
Dan C: For dashboards include burn-rate and rolling error budget window. Suggested Prometheus queries to copy into panels:
```
# p95 latency by model_variant
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_variant))

# kvcache hit rate
sum(rate(kvcache_hits_total[5m])) / sum(rate(kvcache_requests_total[5m]))
```
Leo H: I'll add those panels + a single-pane summary showing current burn rate and last 6 incidents, and overlay the postmortem timeline. Pushing Grafana to staging when ready.
Ashley P: Canary plan: ramp 1% -> 5% -> 25% over 30m with automatic rollback if p95 > 350ms for 60s. I'll own the runbook and a small job to flip model_variant tag.
Maya R: Do NOT change the public SLO number now. Instead add a guardrail alert that triggers when projected burn exceeds 2x over 1h so ops gets early notice without normalizing expectations.
Dan C: Agreed. I'll implement pool isolation config + throttle and open a PR with tests. I'll include a staging experiment to reproduce kvcache eviction in a controlled way.
ops-oncall: I'll take week1 audit rotation (monitor + annotate incidents). Volunteers for weeks 2-4?
Leo H: I'll take week2.
Ashley P: I'll take week3 and validate canary results.
Dan C: I'll take week4 and own config rollouts.
Maya R: I'll add an action tracker section in the postmortem doc with owners and due dates and create the issue board. Will ping #eng-platform when PRs/boards are live.
Dan C: Tracker note: include Alertmanager snippet for guardrail projection:
```
- alert: SLOBurnProjectionHigh
  expr: predict_linear(sum(rate(error_budget_burn[1m])[5m]), 3600) > (2 * error_budget_rate)
  for: 2m
```
Ashley P: Drafting rollback runbook now, will link it in the tracker.
Leo H: Dashboards done, pushed to grafana staging: https://grafana.staging/d/abcd/pool-spike-summary. Sending dashboard link in the thread.
Maya R: Quick sync Thu 09:30 to review status. If blockers appear, ping me + ops-oncall. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
